title: Sanofi breaks ground on insulin plant after securing German government support
snippet: The European Commission approved Germany’s financial support after assessing the risks of Sanofi stopping insulin API production at the Frankfurt campus.

title: EyePoint will halve workforce, end pivotal wet AMD trials early following second fail
snippet: EyePoint is initiating a strategic review after duravyu failed another Phase 3 trial in wet age-related macular degeneration. Amid significant layoffs and trial terminations, the company is shifting attention to the asset’s potential in diabetic macular edema.

title: Merck KGaA makes noise in hematology with $1.1B Silence buy
snippet: Silence Therapeutics’ lead siRNA asset for the rare blood cancer polycythemia vera has been earning analyst raves in a tight race to challenge Takeda in a potential $2 billion market.

title: As AbbVie’s Crohn’s combo beats Skyrizi in mid-stage test, analysts laud autoimmune vision
snippet: AbbVie’s next-gen dual-targeting therapy elicited higher rates of remission than its IL-23 inhibitor Skyrizi in a Phase 2a trial of Crohn’s disease, leading analysts to wonder if the blockbuster can be outdone.
